{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness 插件市场：精选目录 + GitHub 实时浏览、中英翻译搜索、安装前静态安全审计闸门。Plugin market for DeepSeek Harness with a pre-install security audit gate.","id":"gh:1334287625","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"DSH-Plugin-Market","slug":"nanshan1995/DSH-Plugin-Market","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","marketplace","plugin-market","security-audit"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 插件市场：精选目录 + GitHub 实时浏览、中英翻译搜索、安装前静态安全审计闸门。Plugin market for DeepSeek Harness with "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"a pre-install security audit gate."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH-Plugin-Market · Plugin Market"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, one-click install — every install/update pass"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"es a **static security audit gate** first."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Live community browse** of the GitHub `dsh-plugin` topic (ranked by stars / latest, paginated) p"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"lus a personal **My Favorites** list (☆-save, survives restarts)
- **Cross-language search**: Chines"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"e queries find English plugins and vice versa — built-in thesaurus **plus real-time LLM translation*"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"* via the host model
- Pre-install audit of the exact published artifact (dynamic exec, credential a"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ccess, install scripts are hard-blocked); when blocked, the audit card offers **"Install anyway" (fo"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"rced download, at your own risk)** and **"Cancel"** side by side
- In-flight ops (installing / updat"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ing / uninstalling / audit-blocked awaiting decision) are **pinned to the top** of the lists with li"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"ve progress
- Official design language (`--dsw-alias-*` tokens); audit results in the official "requ"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"est approval" pill style
- Update checks, one-click updates (audited too), uninstall with **arm/conf"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"irm on the same button** (click 卸载 → the button becomes 确认卸载? → click again to run; clicking anywher"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"e else reverts it), hot mounting, log export, self-service pnpm setup
- **Git links for every instal"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"led plugin**: each Installed row resolves its repository from `package.json` (`repository` / GitHub "},{"id":"p6s13","text":"`homepage`), the `github:` spec, or a scan of the shipped README — the spec text and a "Source" butt"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"on open the repo
- **In-market README viewer**: HTML tables/images render, relative image links poin"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"t to raw; switch language by clicking the in-README language links (e.g. 中文) — the dialog reloads th"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"at file in place; a ↻ button force-refreshes; READMEs that shipped double-encoded (UTF-8 mis-decoded"},{"id":"p6s17","text":" as GB18030, e.g. `——` → `鈥斺€`) are detected and restored (a "encoding repaired" badge shows; spots "},{"id":"p6s18","text":"already destroyed upstream render as `?`); cache is memory-only, 30-min TTL with a size cap
- **Cros"},{"id":"p6s19","text":"s-platform**: macOS / Windows / Linux (toolchain auto-detected per platform: fnm / Volta / Homebrew "},{"id":"p6s20","text":"/ scoop / %APPDATA%\npm…; Windows uses tar.exe / curl.exe / cmd-compatible spawns)
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> Prerequisites: DeepSeek Harness (`dsh web`) running; pnpm available (the market detects and offers"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" to install it). Windows needs 10 1803+ (bundled bsdtar for the audit step)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Option 1: from GitHub (recommended)**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Option 2: local link (development)**"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Option 3: npm** (once published)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Restart DeepSeek Harness, then open Settings → Plugin Market."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Discover**: browse the whole GitHub `dsh-plugin` topic ranked by stars (50 per load, "Load more""},{"id":"p17s2","text":" to page; GitHub exposes at most 1000 results — the real total is shown, and search reaches the rest"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"); in-flight ops are pinned to the top
- **Search**: live keyword search with zh/en thesaurus **plus"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" LLM translation**; the UI shows "Translated as: …"
- **My Favorites**: ☆ on any community card save"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"s it into your personal list (stored in the profile, survives restarts); favorites support install /"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" update / uninstall / README exactly like the community list
- **Install**: click Install → the real"},{"id":"p17s7","text":" source is downloaded and statically audited → auto-installs on pass; on block, an audit card is sho"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"wn ("Install anyway" to force, "Cancel" to give up, or hand the plugin name to the Agent for manual "},{"id":"p17s9","text":"way" to force, "Cancel" to give up, or hand the plugin name to the Agent for manual review)
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"A standard dsh-plugin (`dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Audit gate (fail-closed)**: before install/update, the exact artifact that would be installed (npm"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" dist tarball or GitHub codeload HEAD) is downloaded into a temp dir and scanned statically — code i"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"GitHub codeload HEAD) is downloaded into a temp dir and scanned statically — code is never executed:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- Graded capability profile: fs read/write, subprocess, network hosts, env vars, credential paths, d"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ynamic execution (`eval`/`vm`/`new Function`), service injection, bundle patch, dependencies
- Hard "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"blocks (risk=review): dynamic execution, credential paths/sensitive env vars, patches that override "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"other plugins
- Additional hard rules: `preinstall`/`install`/`postinstall` (plus `prepare` for git "},{"id":"p22s5","text":"installs) are always blocked; any audit failure blocks
- The report card shows risk level, permissio"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"n chips and each finding (file:line + evidence)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**Search & translation**: GitHub search API (paged, sortable by stars/updated); the query is expande"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"d by the built-in zh/en thesaurus and then translated live by the host LLM (10-min cache, 6s timeout"},{"id":"p23s3","text":", silent fallback to the thesaurus). Translated terms join the GitHub OR-query."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**README fetch**: curl channel (auto proxy detection + direct fallback), language-priority candidate"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"s (`README.zh.md` → `README.md`, rare-name fallback, follows in-README language links), other langua"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ge warm-loaded in the background; content passes encoding repair and relative-URL rewriting; memory-"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"only cache, 30-min TTL + size cap."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Favorites**: stored as a JSON file in the profile (`dsh-plugin-market-favorites.json`), so the per"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"sonal list survives restarts without any third-party catalog dependency."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"**Pagination**: 50 per load for community browse, 20 for search; the client's "Load more" appends ex"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"actly one page of new items (drift-compensating backfill), shows loaded/real totals and notes GitHub"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"'s 1000-result retrieval cap."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Security notes"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The static audit is a **capability radar, not a behavior firewall**: it blocks the highest-risk stat"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ic patterns (dynamic exec, credential theft, install scripts, tampering with other plugins) but cann"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ot judge runtime data-flow intent (e.g. "read documents, then upload"). Curation ≠ endorsement: only"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" install sources you trust, and pair this with a runtime sentinel (e.g. dsh-plugin-audit) and commit"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"sources you trust, and pair this with a runtime sentinel (e.g. dsh-plugin-audit) and commit pinning."}],"truncated":true}
